## Problem and result

What concrete problem does this solve, and what changes for users?

## Verification

List the checks actually run, their results, and remaining limitations. For a workflow change, include a representative request and observed behavior. Mark checks not run.

## Provenance and AI assistance

Identify AI assistance and imported or substantially adapted material. Include source, revision, license, notices, and modifications where applicable. State none when there is nothing to disclose.

## Review

- [ ] Scope and related documentation are consistent.
- [ ] Evidence supports the changed behavior or claim.
- [ ] I can contribute this material under CONTRIBUTING.md, including the output permission where applicable.
